title: Compliance Cadence Workbook: SSO Cutover, Audit Log Retention, and ISO/SOC2 Milestone Gates
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Objective: Create a single, actionable milestone workbook that coordinates SSO (SAML/OIDC) cutover work, audit log retention and export controls, and SOC2/ISO gates. The workbook will be the source of truth for owners, rollouts, required artifacts (evidence), and cutover readiness checks.

Scope:
- Define milestone gates and pass/fail criteria for SSO cutover and verification in staging and production environments.
- Capture audit log retention policies, storage/backfill requirements, and emergency export/runbook procedures.
- Map SOC2 and ISO control evidence to implementation tasks and owners, including backlog tickets and PR links.
- Provide a practical go/no-go checklist that cross-references runtime metrics, test coverage, and legal signoffs.

Out of scope: policy drafting (legal will provide final wording), platform KMS implementation details (owned by security infra).

Why now: Customers requiring enterprise controls are delaying Dedicated and Private deployments pending concrete evidence and clear cutover plans for SSO and audit logging. This workbook reduces friction in sales and on-boarding and unblocks release gates for enterprise customers.
acceptance_criteria: Workbook lists all milestone gates with owners, expected artifacts, and binary acceptance criteria
SSO cutover checklist verified by identity engineering in staging and dry-run in production shadow mode
Audit log retention settings documented with retention buckets, cost estimate, and retention test scripts
All SOC2/ISO control mappings include example evidence links (PR/Confluence) or assigned action items
Legal and Security have signed off on the go/no-go checklist for customer rollout
milestones: Milestone 1: Draft gate definitions and owner matrix (by 2026-02-20)
Milestone 2: Implement audit-log export proof-of-concept and retention test (by 2026-03-05)
Milestone 3: SSO staging dry-run and monitoring integration (by 2026-03-20)
Milestone 4: Evidence collection and sample audit packet generation (by 2026-03-28)
Milestone 5: Final legal/security review and approved go/no-go (by 2026-04-10)
metrics: Time-to-evidence: mean days from ticket completion to evidence uploaded
SSO cutover errors: rate of authentication failures during staging dry-run
Audit export success rate: percent of scheduled exports that pass integrity checks
Control coverage: percent of SOC2/ISO controls mapped to implemented artifacts
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: SSO provider behaviour differs in production. Mitigation: one-week shadow traffic run and rollback plan
Risk: Log retention costs exceed budget. Mitigation: cost estimates and alternate cold-storage option pre-approved
Risk: Missing evidence for a control. Mitigation: create temporary compensating control and document remediation timeline
